what does parse_dates in report.py do with a date that has no timezone?
In report.py, parse_dates (lines 4-11) parses each row's
r['when'] with datetime.fromisoformat (line 7). If the result
has no tzinfo (line 8), it treats the value as UTC by calling
without shifting the clock time. Every value, naive or aware,
is then converted with astimezone(timezone.utc) (line 10) and
appended to the returned list, so all outputs are UTC-aware
